# HR and behavioral question bank

Pick across categories. Variants matter: interviewers rephrase, and the story bank must survive rephrasing.

## Opening
- Tell me about yourself. / Walk me through your resume.
- Why did you choose computer science / engineering?

## Motivation and fit
- Why do you want to work here?
- Why this role?
- Where do you see yourself in 3–5 years?
- What do you know about our company and products?
- Why should we hire you?
- Are you open to relocation / shifts / a service agreement?

## Self-awareness
- What are your strengths? Your biggest weakness?
- What feedback have you received that you disagreed with?
- What's something you taught yourself recently?

## Behavioral (STAR)
- Tell me about a time you had a conflict with a teammate.
- Tell me about a time you failed. What did you learn?
- Describe a time you showed leadership without authority.
- Tell me about a time you worked under a tight deadline.
- Tell me about the most challenging bug or technical problem you solved.
- Describe a time you had to learn something quickly.
- Tell me about a time you disagreed with a decision and what you did.
- Tell me about a time you went beyond what was asked.
- Describe a project you are most proud of.

## Situational
- You're stuck on a task and your lead is unavailable. What do you do?
- A teammate isn't pulling their weight before a deadline. What do you do?
- You realise you shipped a bug to production. Walk me through your next hour.

## Tricky
- Do you have other offers?
- What are your salary expectations?
- Explain the gap in your education/career. / Why the backlog? / Why the low CGPA?
- If you get a better offer after joining, will you leave?
- Do you plan to pursue higher studies?

## Closing
- Do you have any questions for us?
